description: Source code for a stripped-down version of gettext's envsubst(1), implementing environment variable substitution in shell format strings, with functions for parsing, substitution, and command-line handling.

methods.name: cmd_main
methods.description: Main function handling command-line arguments, performing variable substitution, and closing stderr.

methods.name: find_variables
methods.description: Parses a string to find variable references in shell format, invoking a callback for each variable found.

methods.name: print_variables
methods.description: Prints all variables found in a string.

methods.name: note_variables
methods.description: Stores variables found in a string into a set for substitution.

methods.name: subst_from_stdin
methods.description: Reads from stdin, performs variable substitution based on environment and set variables, and writes to stdout.
